meta.title: Infinite Slop: The AI Livestream Run by Its Chat
meta.description: Infinite Slop is an endless AI livestream from Pieter Levels and fal.ai — chat votes on what happens next, likes earn karma, and the show never stops.

h1: Infinite Slop: the endless show your chat is writing right now

faqs.a: Yes — it streams around the clock, generating its reality-show beats continuously. There are no episodes released on a schedule; the story just keeps producing for as long as the channel runs.

faqs.q: How do I change what happens on the Infinite Slop stream?
faqs.a: Open the channel, watch the current beat, and vote on what the characters do next — or pitch your own direction in chat. The top decision is rendered into the show live.

faqs.q: What is karma on Infinite Slop?
faqs.a: Karma is the reward for participating: liking and contributing earns it, and contributors compete for a cash prize pool ($8,500 at last check). Details and current rules live on the official site.
